access.login_failure.name: Cannot log in to account
access.login_failure.summary: Customers report the app rejects their password and blocks them from getting into their account, sometimes alongside complaints about excessive ads.

billing.premium_only_controls.name: Free tier skip and playback restrictions
billing.premium_only_controls.summary: Free users say recent updates removed or limited basic controls such as skipping songs, going back, choosing tracks, and playing queues without Premium, forcing shuffle-only playback.

catalog.lyrics_availability.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent
catalog.lyrics_availability.summary: Customers report that lyrics appear for some songs but not others, or fail to show at times.

catalog.missing_content.name: Songs and genres missing from catalog
catalog.missing_content.summary: Customers say many songs are absent from the library and that certain genres, such as gospel, have too little content.

catalog.recommendations_quality.name: Unwanted recommendations clutter experience
catalog.recommendations_quality.summary: A customer asks the app to stop pushing recommendations, indicating dissatisfaction with how suggestions are presented or their relevance.

downloads.offline_playback_failure.name: Downloaded music won't play offline
downloads.offline_playback_failure.summary: A customer reports that offline playback does not work, so downloaded music cannot be played without an internet connection.

other.boycott_political.name: Boycott calls over political and religious grievances
other.boycott_political.summary: Some customers say they will uninstall or boycott the app because of its Swedish origin or perceived political and religious stances, such as the Quran burning issue.

other.generic_criticism.name: Vague negative reviews without specific defects
other.generic_criticism.summary: Many customers simply call the app bad, worst, trash, or disappointing without describing any specific problem.

other.other.name: Switching to Spotify for a specific podcast
other.other.summary: One customer moved from Pandora to Spotify to access a particular podcast and no longer uses Pandora.

other.update_regression_generic.name: Recent update made the app worse
other.update_regression_generic.summary: Customers say a recent update is disappointing or made the app useless, without naming which feature broke.

playback.audio_quality.name: Music adjustment settings not working
playback.audio_quality.summary: A customer reports that the music adjustment or equalizer feature does not work properly.

playback.connectivity_errors.name: Cannot connect to internet over Wi-Fi
playback.connectivity_errors.summary: A customer reports being unable to connect to the internet when using Wi-Fi.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.name: App crashes or gets stuck on loading
playback.crash_or_wont_open.summary: Customers report the app freezes on the logo or loading screen, or crashes after an update so it cannot be opened.

playback.device_integration.name: Google Assistant playback fails to start songs
playback.device_integration.summary: Customers say the app acknowledges a playlist request from Google Assistant but does not actually play the songs.

playback.performance_resource.name: Background downloads stall until app reopened
playback.performance_resource.summary: Customers report song downloads get stuck in the background and only resume when they reopen Spotify.

playback.playback_interrupted.name: Music repeatedly stops halfway through
playback.playback_interrupted.summary: Customers report music keeps stopping partway through playback while listening.

usability.ads_frequency_volume.name: Excessive and loud free-tier ads
usability.ads_frequency_volume.summary: Customers feel ads play too frequently, sometimes every one or two songs, and are too loud, making the free experience frustrating.

usability.playlist_queue_management.name: Playlist shuffle and repeat controls lacking
usability.playlist_queue_management.summary: Customers report they cannot repeat a specific part of a song and that playlists play songs in random order without control.

usability.ui_redesign_navigation.name: Disliked home screen and UX redesign rollouts
usability.ui_redesign_navigation.summary: Customers complain that recent home screen and UX changes are poorly received and were pushed out without beta testing.
